1973.websynth.zip: A project bundle, so its sampled parts travel inside the file.
First_Light.websynth.json: One riff, four chords: the whole progression is bar transposes on two banks. POLY filter, hat choke, tempo-locked LFO — and the arp is armed, so hold a key.
Gankogui.websynth.json: Twelve-eight, and three lanes on three different cycles: the bell locked to the 24-tick bar, the riff looping every 16 ticks and the motion lane every 18. The whole machine only lands together once every six bars.
Nocturne.websynth.json: The long, slow one: four sequencer tracks through the POLY filter, with motion driving it.
Right.websynth.json: No drums anywhere — four sequencer tracks and motion carry the whole piece.
Run_Away_2.websynth.zip: The Run Away idea rebuilt as a project bundle, sampled parts alongside the synth.
Slouch.websynth.json: Swing sits at zero — every bit of the drag is per-step micro-timing. The snare is five notches late, the clap trails it by another two, the kick pushes ahead, and one hi-hat lands a third of a step off.
Tosti.websynth.json: Three sequencer tracks over a conga-and-clave kit.
Maison.websynth.json: French house, built around the ducker: the kick keys it, everything else breathes. Two bars of silence, a filter riser, then the drop. Mute the drum lane and the pumping stops with it.
Sweet_Dreams.websynth.json: The sequencer runs at 1/8 over all 16 cells, so every bank holds two bars — the riff and the vocal line each fit one bank, which is how eight banks cover the whole song. Four POLY tracks: bass, both riff lines and the melody or chord on top.
Blue_Monday.websynth.json: Two four-bar halves: the pulsing sequence with its two out-of-phase lines, and the octave bass under the hook and the melody. The drums carry the breaks — the kick roll, the dotted stop, a 32nd-note kick ratchet and the snare-and-clap rolls — over bars where the sequencer rests.
Around_the_World.websynth.json: The four sequencer tracks are the four instruments of the video — bass, the vocal, the guitar riff and the synth — playing one four-bar phrase, and motion lanes on the track mutes bring each part in and out, so the whole arrangement lives in the Motion card. Swing is at 27% for the lazy late 16ths of the pickups.
